ItemID: 1; Title: Echo Show 8 (2nd Gen, 2021 release) - Glacier White - with 30-day FREE trial of Alexa Together (monthly auto-renewal); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently bought an Echo Show 5 and its stand, so another display with a subscription offer is not a priority.
ItemID: 2; Title: NETGEAR Nighthawk WiFi 6 Router (RAX70) 8-Stream Gigabit Router, AX6600 Tri-Band Wireless Speed (Up to 6.6 Gbps), Coverage Up to 2,500 sq.ft. and 40 Devices; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: With my Echo devices and previous Wi-Fi extender purchases, I would investigate this as a home-network upgrade.
ItemID: 3; Title: Blink Whole Home Bundle | Video Doorbell System, Outdoor camera, and Mini camera | HD video, motion detection, Works with Alexa; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: Alexa compatibility fits my recent devices, and the cameras could extend my earlier interest in home security.
ItemID: 4; Title: SABRENT USB 3.2 Rugged Waterproof Enclosure [IP67] for M.2 NVMe SSDs (EC-WPNE); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I use external storage, but I have no established need for an enclosure requiring a separate NVMe drive.
ItemID: 5; Title: Cable Matters USB C to Mini USB Cable (Mini USB to USB C Cable) 3.3 Feet in Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy practical connectivity accessories, but I do not currently have a specific Mini USB connection to solve.
ItemID: 6; Title: WD 2TB Elements Portable HDD, External Hard Drive, USB 3.0 for PC & Mac, Plug and Play Ready - WDBU6Y0020BBK-WESN; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: A portable drive would complement the WD desktop drive I previously bought and suit my interest in accessible storage.
ItemID: 7; Title: Sony WH-XB910N EXTRA BASS Noise Cancelling Headphones, Wireless Bluetooth Over the Ear Headset with Microphone and Alexa Voice Control, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My current interests lean toward computer accessories and connected-home devices; headphones are not a purchase I am looking to make.
ItemID: 8; Title: Logitech MX Keys Mini Minimalist Wireless Illuminated Keyboard, Compact, Bluetooth, Backlit, USB-C, Compatible with Apple macOS, iOS, Windows, Linux, Android, Metal Build - Graphite; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I recently chose a full-size Macally keyboard with a numeric keypad, so this compact replacement is less appealing right now.
ItemID: 9; Title: LuBanSir 9 Pack Extension Cord Holder Organizer, Holds 50lbs Heavy Duty Storage Straps for Garden Hose Storage and Garage Wall Organization; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying a power strip does not give me a current need for heavy-duty garage storage straps.
ItemID: 10; Title: USB C Docking Station Dual Monitor HDMI for Dell HP, Laptop Docking Station USB Type C Hub Multiport Adapter Thunderbolt 3 Dongle USB-C to 2 HDMI,Ethernet,VGA,USB3.1,USB2.0,Audio for Surface, Lenovo; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The extra ports interest me given my peripheral purchases, but I would check my computer's USB-C and display compatibility before choosing it.
